concerns.text: SC-004 is referenced in FR-004 and in tasks (e.g., T006) as the acceptance criterion for the time‑window robustness check, but SC‑004 is not defined anywhere in the specification. This omission means the required acceptance criterion is missing, violating the constraint that all acceptance criteria must be preserved.

Task T005 assumes the ability to fetch 30‑day historical performance snapshots from the IBM Quantum API. The IBM Quantum API only provides the latest calibration snapshot, so obtaining a full 30‑day historical window is not feasible. This weakens FR‑004, which mandates a 30‑day historical performance window for robustness checks, by introducing an unfulfillable requirement.
